check.rateLimited: Checked a moment ago. Try again in a minute.

confirm.title: Update Talaia?
confirm.body: The panel will be unavailable for a few minutes while {{sha}} is built and started.
confirm.backup: A copy of the database is taken before the update. If the new version does not start, the previous one is restored.

progress.title: Update progress
progress.queued: The update is queued. The host helper will start it.
progress.rolledBack: The update failed and the previous version was restored.
progress.unknown: The update state is not available.

updateError.hostHelperMissing: The host update helper is not installed or is not running, so the panel cannot apply updates. On the core machine, check: systemctl status talaia-update.path
updateError.rateLimited: GitHub has rate-limited the update checks. The panel will try again later.
updateError.unreachable: The update server could not be reached. The panel will try again later.
updateError.generic: The update check failed. The panel will try again later.
